    r0.z = -r0.y + r1.x;                                                                  // 41  add r0.z, -r0.y, r1.x
    o0.x = r0.x * r0.z + r0.y;                                                            // 42  mad o0.x, r0.x, r0.z, r0.y

    } else { r0.x = intBitsToFloat(i0.x); r2.x = intBitsToFloat(b2.x ? -1 : 0); r2.y = intBitsToFloat(b2.y ? -1 : 0); }// 76  endif
    return;                                                                               // 77  ret
}

{
    Fo4IsCs_rec3927();
}
